reasons.plausibility: Using a Ti interlayer to improve W-Cu bonding is scientifically reasonable, as it addresses mechanical and chemical compatibility.
reasons.testability: Measuring thermal conductivity and interfacial microstructure before and after irradiation can definitively verify or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a direct, practical way to mitigate interfacial voids and improve thermal transport in W-Cu bonds for nuclear applications.
